اقترعتم (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَعْتُمْ (iqtaraʕtum) /iq.ta.raʕ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
# اُقْتُرِعْتُمْ (uqturiʕtum) /uq.tu.riʕ.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَرَعَ (iqtaraʕa)
